method: Krawczyk + interval Newton in Arb ball arithmetic for f_a(x)=1-a*x^4: X=c0+[+/-r]^2 (square superset of B(c0,r)); F(a)=x_n(a), n=2^(m+1)=1024, x_0=0; N(X)=c0-F(c0)/F'(X); K(X)=c0-Y*F(c0)+(1-Y*F'(X))*(X-c0), Y=1/F'(c0); pass iff 0 notin F'(X), N(X) and K(X) strictly inside X, and inf_{a in X}|x_{2^j}(a)|>0 for j=0..m; implies existence and uniqueness of a superstable parameter of exact period n in B(c0,r)
